AnnotatedDeclaration.description: Machine-readable annotation for exactly one source item.

concepts.description: Closed-vocabulary concept tags used for retrieval.
concepts.title: Concepts

figure_dependencies.description: Figures the argument relies on. Stage 0 drops figures by design (204 sites); recording the dependency lets a reviewer see when a proof reasons from a picture that is not in the corpus.
figure_dependencies.title: Figure Dependencies

formalization_hints.description: Representation hazards. The annotation's strongest observed output.
formalization_hints.title: Formalization Hints

local_definition_hints.description: Declaration ids of prior local definitions this statement needs.
local_definition_hints.title: Local Definition Hints

proof_strategy.description: One- to three-sentence summary of the book's argument.
proof_strategy.title: Proof Strategy

source_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the SourceItem this annotates; detects staleness.
source_fingerprint.title: Source Fingerprint

stated_hypotheses.description: Every hypothesis the book states, including ones stated once at the top of a section and inherited silently. Report 01 §D1: five theorems in the summer corpus are FALSE as formalized because a prose hypothesis had no field to travel in. This field carries a mandatory human gate.
stated_hypotheses.title: Stated Hypotheses

terminology.description: Terms the book introduces or relies on here.
terminology.title: Terminology

AnnotatedDeclaration.title: AnnotatedDeclaration

DependencyFacet.description:
Dependency views, kept denormalised on the record for fast rendering.

The corpus graph is authoritative; these are a materialised projection refreshed by
``CorpusRegistry.refresh_dependency_facets``.

unresolved.description: Raw source references that resolved to no declaration.
unresolved.title: Unresolved

DependencyFacet.title: DependencyFacet

InformalDependency.description:
A dependency the *book* asserts, before any Lean exists.

Report 01 §B6: the summer recorded these in prose only -- 176 of 226 declarations were
cited by name in another declaration's docstring and by nothing else, while 224 of 226
had zero Lean-code references. The informal graph and the formal graph never met.

resolved.description: False when the reference could not be resolved to an id.
resolved.title: Resolved

target_id.description: Declaration id, when the reference resolves.
target_id.title: Target Id

InformalDependency.title: InformalDependency

LeanFacet.description: The Lean side. Every field here is produced or confirmed by Lean tooling.

proof.description: The accepted proof body, once one has been verified. Kept on the record rather than folded into the FormalizationProposal, because the proposal is what stage 2 produced and must stay comparable to what a reviewer approved.
proof.title: Proof

LeanFacet.title: LeanFacet

MappingType.description: How a Lean expression differs in form from its source expression.
MappingType.title: MappingType

MathlibCandidate.description:
A Mathlib name the annotator believes is relevant.

``status`` carries the single highest-signal token in the summer corpus: 446 instances
of ``MISSING -- must be built`` across ten chapters. ``verified`` records whether the
name was actually checked; report 02 §B7 measured the cost of not checking -- 12
declarations written, proved, then archived as exact Mathlib duplicates.

verified.description: True only if the identifier was mechanically confirmed.
verified.title: Verified

MathlibCandidate.title: MathlibCandidate

NotationEntry.description:
One row of the source-notation table.

Report 01 §E.4: 454 notation rows were re-derived across ten chapters, with symbols
like nu, epsilon, delta and omega recurring in six or more. These belong in the corpus
registry once, not per chapter -- but they are *observed* per chapter, so they are
collected here and promoted by the registry.

decided_in.description: Declaration id where this mapping was fixed.
decided_in.title: Decided In

meaning.description: What the book says it denotes.
meaning.title: Meaning

NotationEntry.title: NotationEntry

OpenQuestion.description: Something the annotator could not settle and a human may need to.
OpenQuestion.title: OpenQuestion

ProofStep.description: One step of the book's printed proof, in the book's own terms.

uses.description: Declaration ids or raw references this step invokes.
uses.title: Uses

ProofStep.title: ProofStep

Provenance.description:
Where an artifact came from and what it was produced against.

Report 01 §B4 is the reason this exists and is required on every agent-produced
artifact: the summer's annotations asserted repository facts with no record of the
repository state they were written against, and those assertions went silently false.

context_package_id.description: ContextPackage this artifact was generated from.
context_package_id.title: Context Package Id

corpus_version.description: Corpus registry version this was generated against.
corpus_version.title: Corpus Version

input_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the exact input content (staleness check).
input_fingerprint.title: Input Fingerprint

model.description: Model id, or None if deterministic.
model.title: Model

producer.description: Component that produced the artifact, e.g. 'annotator'.
producer.title: Producer

provider.description: LLM provider, or None for deterministic producers.
provider.title: Provider

Provenance.title: Provenance

ReviewDecision.description:
One human decision, recorded immutably.

``superseded_by`` exists because of issue ``i-033``: exercise 1.5.2 was judged
GENERALIZE and later reversed to DROP when the Mathlib lemma was found. Without
versioned decisions a reversal is indistinguishable from a contradiction.

artifact_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of what was reviewed; a later change makes the decision stale.
artifact_fingerprint.title: Artifact Fingerprint

findings_reviewed.description: CheckerFinding ids this decision was made against.
findings_reviewed.title: Findings Reviewed

ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision

ReviewState.description: Current review state of one declaration.

agent_status.description: What the checkers concluded. Agents may write this freely.

human_decision.description: The standing human decision. Never written by an agent.

risk_factors.description: Per-factor contributions, so the score stays readable.
risk_factors.title: Risk Factors

ReviewState.title: ReviewState

SemanticStatus.description: Whether the Lean form means the same thing as the source form.
SemanticStatus.title: SemanticStatus

SorryKind.description:
What an occurrence of ``sorry`` means.

Report 02 §B4: the summer treated ``def f := sorry`` as interchangeable with
``theorem t := by sorry``. They are not. An unfinished *proof* leaves downstream
results unproved; an unfinished *object* leaves them **vacuous** -- 13 opaque
constants made 18+ theorems meaningless in one module.
SorryKind.title: SorryKind

SourceItem.description:
A single mathematical item as the *book* states it.

Deliberately free of any Lean notion. Rule 3: source terminology, notation, numbering
and statement identity are stored, never replaced. ``statement`` is a verbatim slice of
the chapter markdown -- not a paraphrase -- so that fidelity checking compares against
the book rather than against an agent's summary of it (report 01 §D2).

name.description: Term the book introduces, for unlabelled definitions.
name.title: Name

proof.description: Verbatim printed proof, if the book gives one.
proof.title: Proof

statement.description: Verbatim source text of the statement.
statement.title: Statement

SourceItem.title: SourceItem

SourceItemKind.description:
What the textbook calls this item.

Kept separate from :class:`LeanDeclarationKind`: the book's `definition` may become a
Lean `def`, `abbrev`, `structure` or `Prop`, and an `exercise` may become a `theorem`.
Conflating them is how source identity gets lost (report 01 §B2).
SourceItemKind.title: SourceItemKind

aspect.description: What is being mapped, e.g. 'edge cut' or 'the carrier type'.
aspect.title: Aspect

declared_by_producer.description: True when the formalizer itself declared the divergence. A checker finding that merely confirms a declared mapping is an audit trail entry, not a defect -- this is what keeps the fidelity checker's false-positive rate usable.
declared_by_producer.title: Declared By Producer

justification.description: Why the change is sound, in the producer's own words. Report 02 §C1: the summer wrote these as '## In Lean notation' docstring sections and they are the single most valuable artifact in the corpus -- the container was the problem, not the practice.
justification.title: Justification

source_form.description: The book's form, verbatim where possible.
source_form.title: Source Form

SourceSpan.description:
Character range inside a chapter's Markdown, plus the page it sits on.

Report 01 §B1 measured the loss this prevents: the raw extraction carries 9-24
``<!-- p.NNN -->`` markers per chapter and the annotated chapters carry **zero**, so
page provenance died at the annotation boundary. Holding the span lets ``page`` be
*derived* from the nearest preceding marker instead of being re-typed by an agent.

printed_page.description: Page number as printed in the book.
printed_page.title: Printed Page

start.description: Character offset into the chapter markdown.
start.title: Start

SourceSpan.title: SourceSpan

TrustFacet.description: Whether this declaration may be relied upon. Rule 5: Lean decides, not an LLM.

blocked_by.description: Declaration ids whose untrusted state propagates here. Scheduler input.
blocked_by.title: Blocked By

checked_at_fingerprint.description: Lean source fingerprint the verdict was computed from.
checked_at_fingerprint.title: Checked At Fingerprint

TrustFacet.title: TrustFacet

TrustStatus.description: Whether a declaration may be relied upon. Decided by Lean, never by an LLM.
TrustStatus.title: TrustStatus

description:
The aggregate. ``id`` is source-derived and never changes.

Derived values (:attr:`is_theorem_like`, :attr:`is_foundational`,
:attr:`reverse_dependency_count`) are plain properties, deliberately **not**
serialized fields. Storing a derived value is how it goes stale; the view layer
computes them when rendering, and the artifact on disk stays canonical.
title: DeclarationRecord
